classification: Official training dynamic RGB includes shared environment; eval dynamic RGB intentionally represents foreground without environment. Composite/static use the same alpha compositing expression. Camera training jitter affects environment directions only.
diagnostic_camera_override: Separate true_diagnostic_fixed_eval_directions calls override only the newly constructed Camera instance to remove direction jitter. Official renderer and original Camera source remain byte-identical.
depth_policy: Renderer returns alpha-weighted raw composite/static depth; foreground normalization uses corresponding composite alpha or static_alpha. Train and eval use depth/alpha.clamp_min(1e-5) for composite, with the same harmonic900 environment blend. Static depth normalization here is diagnostic only, paired with static_alpha.
